## Checklist

- [ ] `composer check` passes (tests, PHPStan max, code style)
- [ ] New/changed validator cites a primary source in its docblock
- [ ] Test vectors are independently computed, not copied from a third-party page
- [ ] README updated if a validator's scope or limitations changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under `[Unreleased]`
